text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- The Secretary General of Farabundo Marti Salvador (FMLN) Sanchez Ceren held talks with Senior Politburo member Le Kha Phieu and then the Communist Party's Secretary General, Do Muoi.

-- A special economic zone offering investors some of the cheapest rates in Asia will be set up on the Chinese border in northeastern Vietnam. The zone, to be centred around the Quang Ninh province border town of Mong Cai, will focus on trade, manufacturing and will include a deep-sea port, duty-free shopping amd relaxed visa arrangements between China and Vietnam.
-- The National Assembly has published a five-year development plan, which puts average annual gross dosmetic product growth at 9-10 percent.
-- More than 10,700 cases of smuggling were uncovered between January 1993 and October 1996 in the northern border province of Lang Son alone.
-- The Ministry of Planning and Investment expects a big increase in foreign investment in the last two months of this year compared with the average monthly approval rate in the first ten months.
-- More than 8,000 teenagers attended a two-day camp on AIDS protection in Ho Chi Minh city.
